coverage.note: 1978-01-04 to 1978-12-27. Volume read whole, first meeting January 4, 1978 to last meeting December 27, 1978. Meetings counted: 36 regular and 26 special (site inspections and one special procedural hearing on August 2). Scan gaps: no minutes in the scan for the regular meetings of February 1, 8 and 15, 1978; no minutes for a November 29 regular meeting although the November 15 minutes describe November 29 as the next regular meeting; no minutes for a November 8 meeting although two appeals were continued to that date and were heard November 15 instead; no September 13 meeting appears in the scan. July 5 and 12, 1978 were not held for lack of a quorum. Site inspections scheduled for October 9, November 20, December 11, December 12 and December 15 have no minutes in the scan. Appeal numbers are four digits (e.g. 8078) or V-prefixed (e.g. V-8068), differing from the 1980s pattern. Conflicts recorded as printed: appeal number 8133 for two different appeals; 8160 for two; 8169 for two; 8191 for two; 8226 for two; 8336 for two different appeals at the November 1 meeting; the October 25 minutes give a site inspection date of Friday, October 28 while the special meeting was held Friday, October 27; the December 6 minutes amend a stipulation under Appeal 8391 although the Item 27 stipulation appears in the November 15 ruling on Appeal 8381; Appeal 8329 was withdrawn September 27 and then on calendar for rehearing November 1; the December 13 meeting heading says December 15 and the December 6 heading says December 5, both meetings held on the dates in their texts; the July 24 special meeting heading says July 24 while its text says July 21. Skips of note: appeals about permits revoked or denied because of alleged criminal conduct; appeals with no building address (taxi, driver, peddler, jitney, street artist, mobile caterer); ten firearms-dealer remand appeals and the Superior Court remand in Appeal 7815, whose addresses are never stated; Appeal 8246, whose rehearing was granted July 19 and decided August 2 but whose subject and address are never stated; Appeal 7736, remanded from Superior Court and dropped from calendar pending appellate action, subject never stated; withdrawals and continuances whose subjects are never stated anywhere in the volume. Open threads into 1979: rehearing of Appeal 8386 scheduled January 17, 1979; rehearing of Appeal 8239 granted October 18 but not heard in this volume; Appeal 8397 continued to January 3, 1979; a rehearing granted December 27 with no appeal num
